title: Recovery: Troubleshooting
summary: Diagnose common Recovery failures by shrinking the loop and testing one fix.

blocks.title: Common Failure
blocks.body: If the compass seems unclear, check dimension, target status, expiration, and whether multiple graves share similar ids. Travel slower on the recovery run than on the failed one.

blocks.title: Reset The Loop
blocks.body: If recovery attempts keep failing, stop rushing. Build a cheaper backup kit, change the route, remove extra objectives, and recover in stages.

blocks.title: One Fix At A Time
blocks.body: Change one variable, run a smaller test, and compare the result. Fixing three things at once can hide the part that actually mattered.

blocks.title: Retest Cleanly
blocks.body: Change one variable, test on a smaller route, and keep the fix only if the failure becomes easier to explain.
